description: The signed-in user’s own preferences — which company an interface opens on, the language they read labels in, their timezone and how they like a date and a number written — and the language chain to read labels with: theirs, then the company’s, then the country pack’s. Every one of them may be null, and null means "take the next answer in the chain" rather than a default this installation picked.

company_id.description: Resolve the language chain against this company. Left out, only what the user themselves chose is returned.

name: get_preferences
title: What this user prefers
